# U.S. Core Inflation Rate (Year-over-Year), Jan 2015 – Dec 2016

Below are the approximate year-over-year (YoY) **Core CPI** (All Items Less Food and Energy) figures as reported by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics:

| Month | Core CPI YoY (%) |
|------------|:-----------------:|
| Jan 2015 | 1.6 |
| Feb 2015 | 1.7 |
| Mar 2015 | 1.8 |
| Apr 2015 | 1.8 |
| May 2015 | 1.7 |
| Jun 2015 | 1.8 |
| Jul 2015 | 1.8 |
| Aug 2015 | 1.8 |
| Sep 2015 | 1.9 |
| Oct 2015 | 1.9 |
| Nov 2015 | 2.0 |
| Dec 2015 | 2.1 |
| Jan 2016 | 2.2 |
| Feb 2016 | 2.3 |
| Mar 2016 | 2.2 |
| Apr 2016 | 2.1 |
| May 2016 | 2.2 |
| Jun 2016 | 2.2 |
| Jul 2016 | 2.2 |
| Aug 2016 | 2.3 |
| Sep 2016 | 2.2 |
| Oct 2016 | 2.1 |
| Nov 2016 | 2.1 |
| Dec 2016 | 2.2 |

> **Note:** These figures are based on my training data and may have minor rounding differences compared to official BLS releases. For the most precise numbers, please consult the [Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI database](https://www.bls.gov/cpi/).
